recognize_zh: CD4 免疫染色中，表皮下方的真皮浸潤細胞幾乎全部呈強烈細胞膜陽性，形成緻密一片；表皮內只有少數散在的陽性細胞（可能為 Langerhans 細胞或少量 T 細胞），且表皮與浸潤間有淡染的空隙帶；CD4 陽性為主的真皮浸潤是 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病的定義表型。
features: Dense dermal infiltrate with strong membranous CD4 staining in the vast majority of lymphoid cells
Positive cells are small to medium-sized with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Relatively spared papillary dermis (grenz-like zone) beneath the epidermis
Only scattered CD4-positive cells within the epidermis (Langerhans cells or rare T cells); no epidermotropic sheets
Faint background staining of histiocytes and dendritic cells
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD4 on a skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate in which the large majority of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells show strong membranous staining. The superficial papillary dermis is relatively spared, and only scattered CD4-positive cells are present within the epidermis without significant epidermotropism. The CD4-predominant phenotype, together with scarce CD8-positive cells, is consistent with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder in the appropriate clinical setting of a solitary lesion.

ddx.vs: Mycosis fungoides is also CD4-positive but shows epidermotropic atypical cells and Pautrier microabscesses with a patch/plaque history.
BPDCN cells are CD4-positive but blastic, CD3-negative and positive for CD56, CD123 and TCF4, typically sparing the epidermis with a grenz zone.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
ddx.vs: ATLL is CD4+/CD25+ with CD7 loss, pleomorphic flower-like cells and positive HTLV-1 serology.
